product.title: Compact Manicure Set
product.descriptionHtml:
A compact grooming set for everyday touch-ups at home or on the go.

  • Portable case keeps small tools together
  • Select from the available tool-count and case options
  • A practical addition to a travel or self-care routine

Tools and case details vary by selected option. Please review the product variant before ordering.
